Claim requests started / ended per second
panels.description: Worker-observed HTTP request starts and finishes, including empty responses, errors and cancellations. Finishes do not mean task execution completed. Rates are averaged over one minute.

panels.title: Claim requests in flight
panels.description: Pending worker HTTP claim requests and long polls. Long-poll waiting is included; task execution, backoff and persistent SSE task streams are excluded. Process-local, sampled telemetry; abrupt exits may lose final measurements.

panels.title: Claim requests ended by outcome
panels.description: One finish per HTTP request, whether claimed, empty, error or cancelled. A claimed response can contain multiple tasks. Includes both workflow and activity lanes; excludes persistent SSE task delivery.

panels.title: Claim request latency p95 / p99
panels.description: Worker-observed HTTP latency, including server-held long-poll waiting and transport time, excluding retry backoff and task execution. Aggregates buckets across worker instances before calculating percentiles.

panels.title: Candidate registry occupancy
panels.description: Current in-process candidate credits, reservations and cached task metadata. These process-wide gauges are not task completion counts.

panels.title: Candidate registry memory estimate
panels.description: Estimated managed bytes charged to candidate metadata, credits, and in-flight database pages.

panels.title: Candidate credit capacity fallback rate
panels.description: Rate of candidate acquisitions that could not reserve one bounded credit and used the existing owner-fenced claim fallback.
